items.title: Naval Air Defence Without Platform Boundaries: ASELSAN Takes GÖKDENİZ and GÖKSUR VLS to New Platforms
items.summary: From containerised close-in weapon systems to deployable vertical-launch missile defense, ASELSAN is adapting proven naval technologies to address emerging security needs, including the protection of civilian vessels navigating critical maritime chokepoints. items.title: Navy deploys proof-of-concept Man Overboard Detection System
items.summary: The Navy is developing an automated detection system designed to alert crews when someone goes overboard.
